full_judgment: 15. Both the parties paid rents in the name of recorded owners which were marked as exhibits. PW 1, Md Yeasin Hossain in his evidence narrated all the facts and circumstances graphically and stated also the date of dispossession. He also stated that he was dispossessed on 5th March 1982 and he also denied that they are licensee under the defendants. PW 2, Md Abul Hossain stated that he found plaintiffs' possession while the defendants dispossessed the plaintiffs. PW 3, Fazhil Hague also proved possession and dispossession of the plaintiffs. PW 4, Md Ayub Hossain, son of Mithun Mondal who is admitted owner of 1/3 share of Kishori Mohan stated that there was an exchange between the plaintiffs'-predecessor and Tara Pada and Bijay Kumar in the month of Chaitra, 1356 BS and plaintiffs were dispossessed in 5th March, 1982 from the suit land except Plot Nos. 1600, 1601 and 1605. He denied the suggestion that there was no exchange between the parties. He stated that Mojibur Rahman did not exchange any property with Tara Pado and Bijoy, he denied the suggestion that plaintiffs are licensee in Plot No. 1600, 1601 and 1605. The said PW4 is a vital witness for both the parties as because the defendants also stated that Mithun Mondal got 1/3 property of recorded owners. PW 5, Md Abu Taher, an employee of DC office who brought register of the case No. 1846/1952-53, which proves that there was an Register in respect of aforesaid case which has been produced before the Court. DW 1, Mohibur Rahman, son of Mojibur Rahman stated in his deposition that his uncle exchanged the homestead of Dr. Rashid wherein they have been residing, there was homestead of Ram Das, Bamon Das and Kishori Mohan in Plot Nos. 1601 and 1605 wherein they have 2/3rd share and the plaintiffs are licensee therein. So it is clearly apparent that the defendants are residing in the homestead of Dr. Rashid while the plaintiffs are living in Plot Nos. 1601 and 1605. He admitted that Mithun Mondal got 1/3rd share of Kishori Mohan. He also admitted that previously Monazat Ali and Mobari Mondal resided in Plot No. 1605 and he admitted that he does not know about exchange deed dated 10-6-1952 of Mobari Mondal and also does not know whether the deed was validated from Kushtia Collectoriate in Miscellaneous Case No. 846/1952-53 and also does not know whether power of attorney of Mobari Mondal was lost in 1971. He admitted that his father and uncle started residing Dr. Rashid's homestead on getting it by exchange where they still residing. He stated that his father and uncle lived jointly. DW 2, Md Nafor Uddin stated that Ajizur Rahman and Mojibur Rahman resided in the homestead of Dr. Rashid by exchange. He cannot say how many plots are in the suit land. DW-3, Md Nafal Uddin, son of late Asel Uddin stated that he heard about exchange between Tara Pado and Bijoy with Azijur Rahman and Mojibur Rahman. He stated that Azijur Rahman and Mojibur Rahman lived in the homestead of Dr. Rashid since 1950. The father in law of defendant No. 4, Arshad Ali stated that he does not know with whom Ajizur Rahman and Mojibur Rahman exchanged property. He does not know except Dr. Rashid and Narayan. He although disclosed that he has 18 Bigha land but could not disclose plot Numbers. DW-5, Md Ismail stated that plaintiffs never possessed the suit land but he cannot say the boundary of the suit land. He cannot say his properties except one plot although claimed that he has 12 Bighas of land.
